rows.text: walks the qword array from qword `[rcx]` to the end pointer qword `[rcx+8]`, passing each element to the call at `001B6B50` + 0x23; when that returns non-zero `al` it moves the following elements down one slot through the call at `001B6B50` + 0x3E (destination the element, source the next slot, length the end pointer minus that slot) only when any follow, subtracts 8 from qword `[rcx+8]` and re-tests the same slot, otherwise it advances 8 bytes; an empty array returns at once
tail-jumps through `002DF170` + 0xC with the arguments reordered to (1, `ecx`, 0, `edx`)

returns at once when `rcx` is null; otherwise scans the 16 qword slots at `rcx` and, for each non-null slot whose byte `+0x11` equals `dl`, calls `003339C0` + 0x42 and then `003339C0` + 0x4A on it and zeroes the slot; after the loop it calls `003339C0` + 0x60 with `dl` zero-extended

follows the list that starts at qword `+8` of qword `02EBEF88` through qword `+8` links; in each node it overwrites qword `+0x100` and qword `+0x108` with `rdx` where they equal `rcx`, then walks the sub-chain from qword `+0x118` through qword `+0x30` links, storing `rdx` into qword `+0x18` when that equals `rcx` and otherwise into qword `+0x20` when that equals `rcx`; an empty list returns at once

returns at once when dword `[rcx+0xC4]` is -1; otherwise passes qword `+0xDA8` of the record returned by the call at `00424040` + 0x15 (on dword `[rcx+0x10]`) and dword `[rcx+0xC4]` to the call at `00424040` + 0x27, and when that returns non-null ORs 0x40 into its dword `+0xC`
stores word 0 at `[rcx+0xC]`, word 1 at `[rcx+2]` and byte 1 at `[rcx]`, and returns 1

when byte `[rcx]` is 0, copies dword `+0x10` to `+0x18` and dword `+0x14` to `+0x1C`, stores dword 0x101 at `[rcx]` and dword 0x3F800000 at `+0xC`; when byte `[rcx]` is non-zero it returns without writing
clears bit 0x20 and sets bit 0x10 of byte `[rcx+9]`; then, only when that byte is below 0x40 (unsigned) and byte `[rcx+8]` is 0, stores qword 8 at `+0x10`, word 1 at `+0xA` and byte 1 at `+8`
when bit 0 of byte `[rcx+0x34]` is clear, sets it and zeroes word `[rcx+0x30]`; when the bit is already set it returns without writing

skipped.why: its whole work is the entry instruction (inc of dword 02CA4EDC), followed by ret

notes: 001B6B50: the call at +0x3E goes through the import slot 008C2A40 (not named in the row); its argument reading (rcx = element, rdx = next slot, r8 = end minus next slot) suggests a memmove-style call but the row states only the registers. 003A9590 returns r8 (0 on exit) in rax; not stated as a value. 004715D0: 0x3F800000 is the float bit pattern of 1.0 but the listing does not decode it, so the row gives the raw constant.
